build_VLFuse: build a vision-language fusion module using VLFuse to fuse multi-level visual features with language features
create_BiMultiHeadAttention: create a bidirectional multi-head attention layer that fuses vision and language embeddings with cross-attention
create_BiAttentionBlock: create a BiAttentionBlock to fuse multi-level visual features with language features using bidirectional attention
create_BertEncoderLayer: create a BERT encoder layer with clamped attention scores to prevent numerical overflow and underflow
create_SingleScaleBiAttentionBlock: create a single-scale BiAttentionBlock to fuse a single visual feature map with language features
